title: The verifier's spoiled-ballot openings beside an author panel (definition version 7 with a fixed electorate, opening version 3): definitions, clocks, boards carrying both panels' transcripts and the author approvals, and the pinned default panel, with the rows 2.3 and 6.2 and the report's openings
generator: packages/crypto/scripts/verifier-openings-v3-author-vectors.py, from verifier-ballots-v4-author-vectors.py, verifier-ceremony-vectors.py, ceremony-vectors.py, spoiled-opening-v3-vectors.py and verifier-openings-v3-vectors.py (independent Python implementations); the ballot records are verifier-ballots-v4-author-definition-v7.json's

cases.description: Definition version 7 under a fixed electorate with a 2-of-3 author panel whose seat 3 sent nothing; close falls in period 2, so s_S is at least 3. Both transcripts, the approvals record and the cell-0 ballot in segment 0 (counted whatever s_S is), the tier-2 ballot in segment 4 (rejected as boarded late, 5.5, so never counted); an honest opening in segment 3 (early); in segment 5 an honest opening, one of three picks in question 1 (outside at question 1), a stray one, one failing each check over the author half (opening-shape twice, for a registered author seat's missing randomness and for no author half at all; opening-unqualified for a share hash at author seat 3; opening-vss at flat option 4 of the author half; opening-ciphertext for author seat 2's ciphertext bound to the default panel), and three that re-use a ballot's commitment under other share hashes: the segment-0 ballot's C_j (cast), its author half's E^A_{j,0} alone (cast), and the segment-4 ballot's author half (not cast: that ballot isn't admitted, and the opening is undecided until s_S is known); in segment 6 a byte-identical copy of the honest one (a repeat). The honest openings above the floor may still be early or late once s_S is known, so 6.2 is unverifiable.

Every opening breaks a rule the floor decides: in segment 5 one re-using only the segment-0 ballot's author half (cast), in segment 6 one re-using its C_j (cast) and in segment 7 a copy of the first (repeat). 6.2 fails at the first, opening-cast: an author half's commitment is the ballot's as much as the product is.

An opening in segment 2 whose author seat 2 ciphertext is bound to the default panel, ahead of an honest one in segment 3: both are early, and 6.2 fails at the first with its check's code, opening-ciphertext with panel 2 and seat 2.
An opening re-using the tier-2 ballot's author half, with that ballot in segment 3, the floor itself: counted whatever s_S is, so the opening is cast and 6.2 fails.

The same opening with the tier-2 ballot in segment 4, above the floor: 5.5 rejects that ballot as boarded late, so the opening re-uses no admitted ballot's commitment, and it is undecided until s_S is known, so 6.2 is unverifiable.
The mixed case's honest openings with no approvals record on the copy: the author panel's key set isn't approved, so no ballot is admitted and no opening is judged; 6.2 is not reached.
Both runs, the approvals and ballots, and no opening: 6.2 passes.

Definition version 7 under a fixed electorate, beside the author panel, with an opening in segment 5 made honestly for the same election read as version 6 (its version-6 hash, in the core and in both halves' ciphertexts' associated data): it is opening-stray, so 6.2 fails.
